  induction post with

  | app m fn e _ _ _ fn_ih e_ih =>
    cases Hnorm with | app H1 H2 Hn =>

    cases Hnorm with | ite H1 H2 H3 =>

      (List.Subset.trans (eih H3) fun _ Hin => Or.inr Hin)

    cases Hnorm with | eq H1 H2 =>

theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have key : ∀ (e : Expression.Expr), NormalizedOldExpr e →
      (extractOldExprVars e).Subset (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e) := by

    induction e with
    | const => intros x Hin; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Hin
    | bvar => intros x Hin; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Hin
    | op => intros x Hin; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Hin
    | fvar => intros x Hin; simp [extractOldExprVars] at Hin
    | abs _ _ _ ih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm
      exact ih ‹_›
    | quant _ _ _ tr e trih eih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | quant H1 H2 =>
      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      exact List.Subset.app (trih H1) (eih H2)
    | app m fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
      intros Hnorm
      cases Hnorm with | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split

        intros x Hin

        specialize Hn ?_

        cases Hn
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
      . simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
        exact List.Subset.app (fn_ih H1) (e_ih H2)
    | ite _ c t e cih tih eih =>
      intros Hnorm

      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]

      cases Hnorm with | eq H1 H2 =>
      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      exact List.Subset.app (ih1 H1) (ih2 H2)
  intros x Hin
  exact key post Hnorm Hin

open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have appSub : ∀ (a b c d : List CoreIdent), a.Subset c → b.Subset d →
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) := fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ x hx =>
    List.mem_append.mpr ((List.mem_append.mp hx).imp h₁ h₂)
  have key : ∀ e : Expression.Expr, NormalizedOldExpr e →
      (extractOldExprVars e).Subset (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e) := by
    intros e
    induction e with
    | const | bvar | op | fvar => simp [extractOldExprVars]
    | abs _ _ _ ih => intros ⟨⟩; exact ih ‹_›
    | quant _ _ _ tr e trih eih => intros ⟨H1, H2⟩; exact appSub _ _ _ _ (trih H1) (eih H2)
    | app m fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
      intros ⟨H1, H2, Hn⟩
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]; intros a Ha; exact Ha
      . next Hfalse => exfalso; specialize Hn ?_; constructor; cases Hn; apply Hfalse; rfl

    | ite _ c t e cih tih eih =>
      intros ⟨H1, H2, H3⟩
      exact appSub _ _ _ _ (appSub _ _ _ _ (cih H1) (tih H2)) (eih H3)
    | eq _ e1 e2 ih1 ih2 => intros ⟨H1, H2⟩; exact appSub _ _ _ _ (ih1 H1) (ih2 H2)
  intros Hnorm a Ha
  exact key post Hnorm Ha
```
